title: Canon capture hook for Claude Code

messages.content: Let's wire the Claude Code capture hook for Canon. It should post the whole transcript to POST /api/sessions on every Stop event, with the client token from .env. Keep it plain Node, zero dependencies.

Plan: read the transcript path from the hook payload, map each entry to {role, content, at}, and POST it as a CapturedSession with a stable ses_ id per Claude Code session so re-posting upserts. I'll add a 5 s timeout so a dead server never blocks Claude Code.
Good. I decided the folder layout is career, projects, team and private, with an inbox for anything Jev can't file confidently. Hook writes go to projects only.

Noted. The hook sends sessions, not facts, so the folder decision happens in the distiller. I've set the default grant for claude-code to read projects and career and write projects. We chose plain SSE for the event stream; SpacetimeDB only if there is slack on Saturday.
Tests pass. I shipped the capture hook in PR #7 and merged it to main. Next: the heuristic distiller so the demo runs with no API keys.
Merged. The hook posts a session within 300 ms of each Stop event in local runs; the counter on the dashboard will show real numbers from the live stream, not estimates.

One more thing for the resume side: I'm targeting backend internships for summer 2027, so facts about what I built here should land in career as well. I prefer TypeScript over Python for anything that runs in production.
Understood. Jev will see the career signal on save; the distiller passes the suggested folder along and Jev makes the final call. Deadline reminder: Devpost draft is due Saturday 23:59 PDT.
